# Calendar repo catalog

25 repos and APIs, 8 styles, 9 approaches. Source: [catalog/calendars.json](../../catalog/calendars.json) (snapshot 2026-11-13). Start with the [hub](README.md) to choose an approach.

## Approaches

| Approach | Use when | Not when | Picks |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Build the view from tokens** | You need one simple view (agenda card, mini month) in a dashboard and want it to match the theme exactly. | You need drag-to-reschedule, recurring events or resource views; use a library. | [React DayPicker (shadcn Calendar)](#react-day-picker) |
| **Calendar UI library** | You need full Month/Week/Day views with drag and drop in a web or mobile app. | A small read-only list is enough. | [FullCalendar](#fullcalendar), [Schedule-X](#schedule-x), [React Native Calendars (Wix)](#react-native-calendars), [Calendar (kizitonwose)](#kizitonwose-calendar), [JTAppleCalendar](#jtapplecalendar) |
| **Provider API (Google Calendar v3)** | Events must appear in the client's real Google calendar, with invites and Meet links. | Calendar data never leaves your app; store it in your own database. | [Google Calendar API v3](#google-calendar-api), [laravel-google-calendar (Spatie)](#laravel-google-calendar), [googleapis (API definitions)](#googleapis) |
| **Agent connector (MCP)** | An AI assistant should check availability, draft events or summarize the week. | The action must run unattended without a human approving it. | [Google Calendar MCP (nspady)](#google-calendar-mcp), [gcalcli](#gcalcli) |
| **Self-hosted CalDAV** | The client wants their calendar off Google, on their own server. | Nobody will maintain a server. | [Nextcloud Calendar](#nextcloud-calendar), [Fossify Calendar](#fossify-calendar) |
| **ICS feed or file** | People should subscribe to your app's events in any calendar app (Google, Apple, Outlook) with no login. | Changes must sync both ways; feeds are read-only and refresh slowly. | [ical-generator](#ical-generator), [ical.js](#ical-js), [rrule.js](#rrule) |
| **Sync bridge** | Someone lives in Outlook at work and Google at home and needs both to match. | You control both sides; write to one calendar and invite the other. | [Outlook Google Calendar Sync](#outlook-google-sync) |
| **Booking page** | Clients pick their own time for a call. | Only internal scheduling. | [Cal.com](#cal-com) |
| **Video meetings** | Each event needs a join link. | Never build your own video stack for a CRM. Attach a Google Meet link through the Calendar API. | [Google Calendar API v3](#google-calendar-api), [Video Meeting (0x5eba)](#video-meeting), [Google Meet clone (ckalgos)](#google-meet-clone) |

## Calendar UI components

Draw month, week, agenda and picker views inside your own app.

<a id="kizitonwose-calendar"></a>
### Calendar (kizitonwose)

https://github.com/kizitonwose/Calendar · Kotlin · **MIT** (Permissive: MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD. Use in any project. Keep the license notice.) · active (last commit 2026-08-13)

Logic-only calendar for Android Views and Compose Multiplatform. You draw every cell; it handles weeks, months, years, ranges and a heatmap mode.

**Styles:** Month grid, Week strip, Year heatmap, Date and range picker

**Use when**
- Native Android or Compose Multiplatform app
- You want a fully custom look (week strip, heatmap, range picker)

**Avoid when**
- Web or React Native projects

**How to integrate**
1. Add the compose or view artifact from Maven Central
1. Start from the sample app's closest example (week, month, heatmap)
1. Map design tokens to Compose theme colors; draw day cells with them

**Lesson:** Separate date logic from rendering. The library owns the calendar math, you own every pixel.

<a id="huanghaibin-calendarview"></a>
### CalendarView (huanghaibin)

https://github.com/huanghaibin-dev/CalendarView · Java · **Apache-2.0** (Permissive: MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD. Use in any project. Keep the license notice.) · stable (last commit 2025-12-04)

Canvas-drawn Android calendar built for speed and low memory, with many prebuilt styles (Chinese lunar dates, ranges, multi-select).

**Styles:** Month grid, Week strip, Date and range picker

**Use when**
- Android app that needs a fast, styled month view with lunar or marker support

**Avoid when**
- You need the iOS-style vertical/horizontal switch: that part is closed source after 3.7.1
- Compose-first apps; prefer kizitonwose

**How to integrate**
1. implementation 'com.haibin:calendarview:3.7.1' (AndroidX)
1. Subclass MonthView / WeekView and draw with Canvas
1. Follow QUESTION.md for the English docs

**Lesson:** Drawing on a canvas instead of nested views keeps scrolling smooth with many markers.

### FullCalendar

https://github.com/fullcalendar/fullcalendar · TypeScript · **MIT** (Permissive: MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD. Use in any project. Keep the license notice.) · active (last commit 2026-11-12) · added by the toolkit

The most widely used web calendar: month, week, day and list views, drag to move or resize, Google Calendar and ICS sources. Resource timelines are a paid add-on.

**Styles:** Month grid, Week time grid, Agenda list

**Use when**
- Full scheduling screen in a web app (bookings, team calendar)
- Showing a Google calendar or ICS feed inside the app

**Avoid when**
- You need resource/timeline views and no budget for the premium license
- A simple agenda card

**How to integrate**
1. npm i @fullcalendar/react @fullcalendar/daygrid @fullcalendar/timegrid @fullcalendar/interaction
1. Theme it by setting its --fc-* CSS variables from design tokens
1. Load events on open and on change (eventSources function), never on a timer

**Lesson:** Event sources as functions (fetch for the visible range) keep big calendars fast.

**Catalog entry:** [fullcalendar](../tools/calendar.md#fullcalendar)

<a id="nextcloud-calendar"></a>
### Nextcloud Calendar

https://github.com/nextcloud/calendar · Vue / PHP · **AGPL-3.0** (Copyleft: GPL or AGPL. Study it, run it as a separate service, or fork it as open source. Do not paste its code into a closed client app.) · active (last commit 2026-11-13)

Full calendar app for Nextcloud: CalDAV sync, attendees, free/busy, reminders, appointment booking and Talk rooms. Built on FullCalendar and ical.js.

**Styles:** Month grid, Week time grid, Agenda list

**Use when**
- Client wants a self-hosted calendar off Google
- Studying a complete, accessible calendar UX (free/busy, attendees, booking)

**Avoid when**
- Embedding code into a closed client app (AGPL)
- Nobody can maintain a Nextcloud server

**How to integrate**
1. Install from the Nextcloud app store on the client's server
1. Your app talks to it over CalDAV (tsdav or cdav-library), not by importing its code

**Lesson:** Free/busy next to the attendee list is the clearest way to pick a meeting time.

## Provider APIs & SDKs

Read and write real calendars (Google, CalDAV, Outlook) from your backend.

<a id="laravel-google-calendar"></a>
### laravel-google-calendar (Spatie)

https://github.com/spatie/laravel-google-calendar · PHP · **MIT** (Permissive: MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD. Use in any project. Keep the license notice.) · active (last commit 2026-11-05)

Eloquent-style Event model for Google Calendar in Laravel: create, list, update, delete, add attendees and a Meet link in a few lines.

**Use when**
- The backend is Laravel
- A service account or OAuth calendar should mirror app bookings

**Avoid when**
- Next.js / Node stacks (use googleapis for Node)

**How to integrate**
1. composer require spatie/laravel-google-calendar
1. Service account JSON in env, share the calendar with the service account email
1. $event->addMeetLink() for video calls

**Lesson:** Treat the external calendar like a model: new Event, set fields, save(). That's the API shape to copy in any stack.

---

<a id="googleapis"></a>
### googleapis (API definitions)

https://github.com/googleapis/googleapis · Protocol Buffers · **Apache-2.0** (Permissive: MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD. Use in any project. Keep the license notice.) · active (last commit 2026-11-12)

Google's public API definitions. Has the Meet REST API (google/apps/meet/v2: spaces, conference records, transcripts) and the Workspace Events API (google/apps/events) for push subscriptions. Calendar v3 itself is a REST API documented separately, not in this repo.

**Use when**
- Reading Meet conference records, participants or transcripts after a call
- Subscribing to Workspace events instead of polling

**Avoid when**
- Plain calendar work; use the Calendar v3 REST client (googleapis npm package)

**How to integrate**
1. Don't clone it into the app; use the generated client libraries
1. Read google/apps/meet/v2/resource.proto to learn the conference record shape
1. Use the Workspace Events API to get pushed meeting events

**Lesson:** Meeting data (who joined, transcript) and calendar data (when, who's invited) are separate APIs. Join them on the event's Meet code.

---

<a id="google-calendar-api"></a>
### Google Calendar API v3

https://developers.google.com/calendar/api/guides/overview · REST · **Google API terms** (Permissive: MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD. Use in any project. Keep the license notice.) · active · added by the toolkit

The official API behind every Google calendar integration: events, free/busy, incremental sync with sync tokens, push notifications via watch channels, and Meet links via conferenceData.

**Use when**
- Two-way sync between the CRM and the client's Google calendar
- Creating meetings with a Meet link from the app

**Avoid when**
- Read-only sharing to many people; an ICS feed is simpler

**How to integrate**
1. Follow docs/calendars/01-integration-playbook.md: OAuth scopes, sync tokens, watch channels
1. Use the googleapis npm package from a server route; never call it from the browser with a secret

**Lesson:** Sync tokens plus push channels means you never poll.

**Catalog entry:** [google-calendar-api](../tools/calendar.md#google-calendar-api)

## Agent & automation

Let an AI agent or a script check availability and manage events.

<a id="google-calendar-mcp"></a>
### Google Calendar MCP (nspady)

https://github.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp · TypeScript · **MIT** (Permissive: MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD. Use in any project. Keep the license notice.) · active (last commit 2026-10-29)

MCP server that gives an AI assistant Google Calendar tools: multi-account, multi-calendar listing, conflict detection, free/busy, recurring edits and event import from images or PDFs.

**Styles:** Agenda list, Week time grid

**Use when**
- An agent should check availability or draft events across several Google accounts
- Building or testing calendar features with Claude

**Avoid when**
- The hosted Google Calendar connector already covers the need
- Unattended writes; keep a human approval step

**How to integrate**
1. Create a Google Cloud project, enable Calendar API, make a Desktop OAuth client
1. Add the server to your MCP config with the credentials path
1. Start read-only; allow create/update once the approval flow is in place

**Lesson:** Conflict detection across accounts is the feature people actually want from a calendar assistant.

**Catalog entry:** [google-calendar-mcp](../tools/calendar.md#google-calendar-mcp)

<a id="gcalcli"></a>
### gcalcli

https://github.com/insanum/gcalcli · Python · **MIT** (Permissive: MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD. Use in any project. Keep the license notice.) · active (last commit 2025-10-24)

Google Calendar from the terminal: agenda, week and month text views, search, quick-add, ICS import, conflict finding and reminder hooks.

## Sync & interoperability

Move events between systems: ICS files, recurrence rules, Outlook to Google.

<a id="outlook-google-sync"></a>
### Outlook Google Calendar Sync

https://github.com/phw198/OutlookGoogleCalendarSync · C# · **MPL-2.0** (File copyleft: MPL-2.0. Use as a dependency freely; changes to its own files must stay open.) · active (last commit 2026-11-01)

Free Windows tool that syncs Outlook and Google calendars one or both ways, including attendees and reminders. Works behind proxies, no install required.

**Use when**
- A client keeps a work Outlook and a personal Google calendar and the CRM reads Google

**Avoid when**
- Mac-only users
- You can use Microsoft Graph directly from the backend

**How to integrate**
1. Client installs it on their Windows PC
1. Point it at the Google calendar your app reads
1. Document it in the handover guide; it's a user tool, not app code

**Lesson:** Sync tools need clear direction (one-way vs two-way) and a dry-run. Show both in any sync settings UI.

<a id="ical-js"></a>
### ical.js

https://github.com/kewisch/ical.js · JavaScript · **MPL-2.0** (File copyleft: MPL-2.0. Use as a dependency freely; changes to its own files must stay open.) · active (last commit 2026-11-06) · added by the toolkit

Parses and writes iCalendar (ICS) and vCard, with time zones and recurrence. Used by Thunderbird and Nextcloud.

**Use when**
- Importing ICS files or invites into the app
- Expanding recurring events from a CalDAV server

**Avoid when**
- You only need to generate feeds; ical-generator is simpler

**How to integrate**
1. npm i ical.js
1. ICAL.parse → new ICAL.Component → iterate vevent
1. Use its recurrence iterator for expanding occurrences in a date range

**Lesson:** Always expand recurrence for the visible range only, never forever.

### rrule.js

https://github.com/jkbrzt/rrule · TypeScript · **BSD-3-Clause** (Permissive: MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD. Use in any project. Keep the license notice.) · stale (last commit 2023-11-10) · added by the toolkit

Recurrence rules (RFC 5545 RRULE) in JS, with plain-English output like 'every week on Monday'.

**Use when**
- Repeating follow-ups ('every 2 weeks') stored as an RRULE string
- Showing a human description of a repeat rule

**Avoid when**
- Time zone-heavy recurrence; check DST behavior or use ical.js

**How to integrate**
1. npm i rrule
1. Store the RRULE string in the database, expand on read for the visible range
1. rule.toText() for the label in the UI

**Lesson:** Store the rule, not the occurrences.

**Catalog entry:** [ics-tools](../tools/calendar.md#ics-tools)

Video rooms, meeting grids and join links that attach to events.

<a id="video-meeting"></a>

https://github.com/0x5eba/Video-Meeting · JavaScript · **None** (Look only: No license or all rights reserved. Read it for ideas; do not copy code.) · stale (last commit 2021-02-26)

Small peer-to-peer video room (React, Node, Socket.IO, WebRTC) with chat and screen sharing, no accounts.

**Styles:** Meeting grid

**Use when**
- Learning how WebRTC signalling works

**Avoid when**

### Google Meet clone (ckalgos)

https://github.com/ckalgos/google-meet-clone · JavaScript · **None** (Look only: No license or all rights reserved. Read it for ideas; do not copy code.) · stale (last commit 2022-09-02)

Tutorial video-conference app with Firebase signalling, screen sharing and a responsive grid for 8 to 12 people.

**Styles:** Meeting grid

**Use when**
- Studying responsive meeting grids for desktop and mobile

**Avoid when**
- Copying code (no license)
- Production video

**How to integrate**
1. Reference only for grid layout at different participant counts

**Lesson:** Grid columns step with participant count (1, 2, 4, 9, 12) so tiles stay large.

<a id="google-meet-grid-view"></a>
### Google Meet Grid View

https://github.com/FugiTech/google-meet-grid-view · JavaScript · **All rights reserved** (Look only: No license or all rights reserved. Read it for ideas; do not copy code.) · retired (last commit 2020-06-17)

Former extension that forced an equal-tile grid in Google Meet, with speaker highlight and 'hide no-video' options. Meet now has this built in.

**Styles:** Meeting grid

**Use when**
- Reference for meeting-grid options: include yourself, highlight speaker, hide tiles without video

**Avoid when**
- Using the code (all rights reserved)
- Modern Meet already has tiled layout

**How to integrate**
1. Copy the ideas, not the code: the three toggles make a good meeting-recap view

**Lesson:** Highlight the speaker with a border, never by resizing, so nothing jumps.

<a id="google-meet-scheduler"></a>
### Google Meet Scheduler

https://github.com/AmanRaj1608/Google-Meet-Scheduler · JavaScript · **None** (Look only: No license or all rights reserved. Read it for ideas; do not copy code.) · stale (last commit 2021-07-23)

Bot that logs into Google with a stored password and joins Meet calls on a schedule using browser automation. Windows only.

**Use when**
- As an example of what not to build

**Avoid when**
- Always for client work: it stores a Google password in a file, automates login (against Google's terms) and acts without a person

**How to integrate**
1. Don't. To get meeting notes, use a recorder connector (Fathom, Fireflies) or the Meet REST API with OAuth

**Lesson:** Automation must use OAuth and an approval step, never stored passwords.

## Styles

### Month grid

Six-week grid with event chips. The default answer to 'show me my month'. Pattern: Overview.

- **Use when:** Planning across weeks; Events are mostly all-day or few per day
- **Avoid when:** More than 3 timed events a day; use Week
- **Rules:** Show 6 rows so the grid never jumps height; Today gets a filled marker, selected day a ring; Overflow becomes '+2 more', never a scroll inside a cell; Arrow keys move between days (roving tabindex)
- **Repos:** [Calendar (kizitonwose)](#kizitonwose-calendar), [CalendarView (huanghaibin)](#huanghaibin-calendarview), [JTAppleCalendar](#jtapplecalendar), [React Native Calendars (Wix)](#react-native-calendars), [rc-calendar](#rc-calendar), [Nextcloud Calendar](#nextcloud-calendar), [Fossify Calendar](#fossify-calendar), [gcalcli](#gcalcli), [React DayPicker (shadcn Calendar)](#react-day-picker), [FullCalendar](#fullcalendar), [Schedule-X](#schedule-x)

### Week time grid

Hours down the side, days across. Overlapping events sit side by side. Pattern: Detail over time.

- **Use when:** Timed meetings and calls; Finding gaps in a day
- **Avoid when:** Phones under 400px wide; switch to 3-day or Agenda
- **Rules:** All-day lane above the hours; Current-time line only on today, updated once a minute while visible; Event height = duration; min height fits one line; Scroll to working hours on open
- **Repos:** [React Native Calendars (Wix)](#react-native-calendars), [Nextcloud Calendar](#nextcloud-calendar), [Fossify Calendar](#fossify-calendar), [Google Calendar MCP (nspady)](#google-calendar-mcp), [gcalcli](#gcalcli), [FullCalendar](#fullcalendar), [Schedule-X](#schedule-x)

### Agenda list

Upcoming events grouped by day. Best on phones and in a Today view. Pattern: List.

- **Use when:** Phones; Today / This week cards on a dashboard; Screen readers (a list is the most accessible calendar)
- **Avoid when:** Spotting free time; use Week
- **Rules:** Sticky day headers; Time, title, who: in that order; Empty days are skipped, with 'Nothing else this week' at the end
- **Repos:** [React Native Calendars (Wix)](#react-native-calendars), [Nextcloud Calendar](#nextcloud-calendar), [Fossify Calendar](#fossify-calendar), [Google Calendar MCP (nspady)](#google-calendar-mcp), [gcalcli](#gcalcli), [Google Calendar for Chrome](#google-calendar-crx), [FullCalendar](#fullcalendar), [Schedule-X](#schedule-x)

### Date and range picker

Mini month for choosing a date or a range inside a form. Pattern: Form control.

- **Use when:** Due dates, follow-up dates, report ranges; Booking check-in / check-out
- **Avoid when:** Dates far in the past (birthdays); a typed field is faster
- **Rules:** Typed input always works too; Range shows start, end and the days between; Disabled dates explain why on focus; Enter selects, Escape closes, focus returns to the field
- **Repos:** [Calendar (kizitonwose)](#kizitonwose-calendar), [CalendarView (huanghaibin)](#huanghaibin-calendarview), [JTAppleCalendar](#jtapplecalendar), [React Native Calendars (Wix)](#react-native-calendars), [rc-calendar](#rc-calendar), [React DayPicker (shadcn Calendar)](#react-day-picker)

### Year heatmap

One square per day, shaded by activity. Shows rhythm over a year. Pattern: Data viz.

- **Use when:** Activity history (calls, sessions, sales) over months
- **Avoid when:** Exact values matter; pair with a number or a tooltip
- **Rules:** Sequential palette from one hue; Every square focusable or summarized in text; Legend with the actual ranges
- **Repos:** [Calendar (kizitonwose)](#kizitonwose-calendar)

### Booking slots

Pick a day, then a free time. The visitor's time zone is shown and changeable. Pattern: Flow.

- **Use when:** Clients booking a call with you; Discovery calls from a website
- **Avoid when:** Internal scheduling between colleagues; use free/busy in Week
- **Rules:** Only free slots are shown; nothing to fail later; Time zone visible and editable; Confirm step summarizes before booking; Sends a calendar invite with the video link
- **Repos:** [Cal.com](#cal-com)

### Week strip

A swipeable row of days with dots, above a list of that day's events. Pattern: Mobile navigation.

- **Use when:** Phone-first apps; Day-at-a-time workflows (appointments, classes)
- **Avoid when:** Desktop planning; use Month or Week
- **Rules:** Dots show 'has events', not counts; Selected day stays centred; Buttons for previous / next week as well as swipe
- **Repos:** [Calendar (kizitonwose)](#kizitonwose-calendar), [CalendarView (huanghaibin)](#huanghaibin-calendarview), [JTAppleCalendar](#jtapplecalendar), [React Native Calendars (Wix)](#react-native-calendars), [Fossify Calendar](#fossify-calendar)

### Meeting grid

Equal tiles for every participant, speaker highlighted. For video meeting UIs. Pattern: Live view.

- **Use when:** Building a video room or a meeting recap screen
- **Avoid when:** Meetings are better handled by Meet or Zoom links; don't build video unless it is the product
- **Rules:** Tiles keep 16:9 and reflow by count; Speaker highlight uses a ring, not size change (no layout shift); Names always visible; initials when video is off
- **Repos:** [Video Meeting (0x5eba)](#video-meeting), [Google Meet clone (ckalgos)](#google-meet-clone), [Google Meet Grid View](#google-meet-grid-view)
